summary.label: genotype-level candidates: two claims from the project’s own genotype data and eight scenarios written here to exercise the five genotype checks
summary.rankingNote: Rank nothing by elimination count: a problem with more eliminated candidates is not more solved; it only had more candidates these theorems happen to touch.

ledger.problem: Is the slc43a2a F326L flying-fish variant reachable by one nucleotide substitution?
ledger.description: Daane et al. 2021 report F326L in slc43a2a (lat4a) as a single SNP present in at least 7 of 9 sequenced flying-fish species (medaka protein numbering). Claim: phenylalanine to leucine in one substitution.
ledger.source: genotype/map.vetted.json (lat4a_rows: F326L; SNP table notes); Daane JM et al. 2021 Curr Biol doi 10.1016/j.cub.2021.08.054
ledger.verdict: consistent (not ruled out by these theorems; not shown feasible)
